metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: grade
plugins.description: Strict, evidence-driven software quality audit. Multi-domain scoring anchored to ISO/IEC 25010 (McCabe, NIST, SonarQube, OWASP). Full + diff modes, trend tracking, divergent-path findings, multi-language.

plugins.name: rationalize
plugins.description: Divergent-path analysis and convergence planning for duplicated workflows, contracts, APIs, schemas, services, UI paths, tests, and legacy/current code paths.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Codex code review closeout helper for local patches, PR branches, and parallel verification.

plugins.name: pr-delivery
plugins.description: End-to-end pull request delivery workflow for commit, push, PR creation, CI/review monitoring, safe merge, verification, and cleanup.

plugins.name: frontend-pr-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous frontend/UI improvement loop that chooses a bounded change, verifies it, and delivers it through a merged PR.
